consent.title: Before you start
consent.intro: League of Maybes is a private notebook about the people you date. Please read and accept these points.
points: You are responsible for everything you write about other people.
Use nicknames, never real names. A phone number is optional.
Your roster is private: only you can see it.
Opener suggestions send the relevant notes to Google Gemini.
The AI brief is copied by you, into the AI tool of your choice.
consent.checkbox: I have read and accept the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.

sections.title: What the app is
sections.body: League of Maybes is a private, single-user notebook that helps you keep track of the people you are getting to know: notes, dates, plans and chat habits. It is not a dating service and does not connect you with anyone.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: You sign in with your Google account. Keep that account secure: anyone who can sign in to it can see your roster.

sections.title: Your responsibility for the data you enter
sections.body:
Everything in the app is written by you, and much of it is about other people. You are solely responsible for that content and for having the right to keep it.
Use nicknames, never real names. Do not record more about anyone than you need, and avoid sensitive details such as religion or political views. Health notes and cycle tracking are optional health data: enter them only when they help, and only what you need. A phone number is optional and only used to open a chat.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not use the app to harass, track, expose or harm anyone. Do not share or publish what you store about other people.

sections.title: AI features
sections.body:
When you ask for opener suggestions, the relevant notes about that person are sent to Google Gemini through Firebase to generate them. The suggestions are not stored.
The AI brief is copied to your clipboard; if you paste it into another AI tool, that tool's own terms apply.

sections.title: No warranty
sections.body: The app is provided as is, without any guarantee of availability or fitness for a purpose. Reminders and suggestions are hints, not advice.

sections.title: Ending use
sections.body: You can stop using the app at any time. From the Account page you can export your data and delete your account with all its data, using the deletion code you set beforehand. Deletion is final: the data cannot be recovered.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: If these terms change, the version above changes and you are asked to accept them again before continuing.

sections.title: What is stored
sections.body: Your basic Google profile (name, email, photo) as provided by Firebase Authentication, and the content you enter: players, traits, notes, dates, plans, chat settings, optional health notes and cycle data, your personal details and, if you enable notifications, a device token with its language.

sections.title: Where it is stored
sections.body: In Google Firebase (Cloud Firestore), in the European multi-region (eur3).

sections.title: Who can see it
sections.body: Only you. Security rules allow each account to read and write its own data only. The data is not shared, sold or used for advertising.

sections.title: Health data
sections.body: Health notes and cycle tracking (period dates, cycle lengths and phase notes) are optional health data that you enter yourself. They are stored and protected like the rest of your data, visible only to you, never sent to AI, and deleted with the player they belong to or with your account. Phases are estimates, not medical advice.

sections.title: AI processing
sections.body: Only when you request opener suggestions, the selected notes about that person and your interface language are sent to Google Gemini through Firebase AI Logic. The app does not store the request or the answer.

sections.title: Notifications
sections.body: If you turn on nudges, your device's push token is stored so reminders can reach you. Notifications use generic text and never show a nickname.

sections.title: Stored in your browser
sections.body: Your theme, your language and a few small display preferences are kept in your browser's local storage.

sections.title: Retention and deletion
sections.body: Your data is kept until you delete it. From the Account page you can export everything as a file, or delete your account with all its data using your deletion code. Deletion is immediate and permanent; nothing can be recovered afterwards. The deletion code is stored only as a secure hash.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any question about your data, contact the owner of this app.

export.title: Export your data
export.body: Download everything stored in your account as a JSON file: players, traits, notes, dates, plans, chat settings and devices.
export.error: The export could not be created. Please try again.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.finalTitle: Deletion is final and cannot be undone
delete.finalBody: Deleting your account permanently erases your whole roster and everything in it (players, notes, dates, plans, chat settings and devices), together with your sign-in. Nothing is kept: there is no backup, no recycle bin and no undo. Neither you nor the owner of the app can recover the data afterwards. Export your data first if you might ever want it again.
delete.confirmBody: Enter your deletion code to confirm. Your data is erased the moment you press the button.
delete.understood: I understand that my account and all its data will be permanently deleted and can never be recovered.
delete.error: The account could not be deleted. Please try again.

code.intro: Deleting the account needs a deletion code, so it can never happen by accident. Set one now and keep it somewhere safe: you need it to delete the account and to change the code.
code.label: Deletion code
code.forgot: Forgot it? Contact the owner of the app.
code.locked: Too many wrong codes. The code is locked for an hour.
